verdict_text: NO. The second task vector is computed against the already-modified base: the plan applies `add_` of tv1 into the base MLP tensors before it copies ft2 and subtracts the base to form tv2, so tv2 = ft2 - (base + 0.4*(ft1 - base)) rather than ft2 - base. The output is therefore base + 0.24*(ft1 - base) + 0.4*(ft2 - base), which violates Required result step 2 (each task vector must be taken against the unmodified base, the ordering hazard the spec explicitly calls out). The merged tensors will exceed the 1e-5 relative Frobenius tolerance. Fixing it requires forming both task vectors (or at least subtracting the base from tv2) before the first `add_` into the base.
expected_defect: Task vector 2 is computed against the base after task vector 1 has already been added, so the second delta is taken from the wrong reference point.
